Dear Amanda,

Thank you for your interest in upgrading your service plan with us.

Your upgrade request has been received and is being processed by our account team.

We have received your requirements for:
- Increased user seats (from 10 to 50)
- Advanced analytics dashboard
- Priority support

Our account team will review your request and reach out to you shortly with next steps and pricing information.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
CRM Assistant Team
